name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct as EXCAVA’s primary inference engine. Its MoE design delivers 235B active parameters with only 22B engaged per token, cutting compute cost by 40% while matching or beating Llama-3.1-70B on benchmarks. The trade-off is higher memory pressure—you need 4x the VRAM of a dense 70B model—but the net capability gain per dollar spent outweighs the hardware bump.

name: Torque
text: Qwen3-235B-A22B’s MoE routing overhead spikes EXCAVA’s latency at scale—its 22B engaged parameters still demand 4x VRAM, and the routing delay eats the compute savings. Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct’s flat 70B cost hides a real risk: its dense architecture avoids MoE’s latency spikes but locks you into a single model path. Test both under EXCAVA’s real load—if Qwen3’s 0.5% benchmark gain disappears in production, default to Llama-3.1-70B and optimize elsewhere.
